messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: New incident INC-6791 - EdenWorks (private VPC, dedicated pool dp-42). Symptoms: elevated 5xx (502/504) on text-gen endpoints since 2026-03-16T14:05Z. Probable area: NLB target flapping. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-egress
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. pinging @Ben @Ajay. Triage window starting.
Ben (eng-sre): looking at metrics and target health. NLB target group tg-dp42 shows ~60% unhealthy, healthcheck /hb returning 504. Pods in eden-prod showing restarts.
Ajay (net-ops): seeing burst of conntrack entries from tenant subnet 10.45.32.0/24, NAT gateway SNAT port usage spiking. There was an SG tighten PR applied ~12:30 — could be related.
Emily (support): CS reports customer-facing errors and queueing. SLA is impacted. Rachel, please coordinate external comms.
Rachel (customer-success): on it — opening a bridge and will send initial note: "We see elevated errors, mitigation in progress; will update shortly."
Ben (eng-sre): quick check -> `kubectl get pods -n eden-prod -l app=model-api -o wide`
`NAME               READY STATUS       RESTARTS AGE   IP          NODE`
`model-api-7c9f8d   1/1   CrashLoop    4        3d   10.45.32.12  node-7`
Maya (oncall): don't want cross-tenant blast radius. Can we shift EdenWorks traffic to the warm dedicated pool dp-43?
Ajay (net-ops): yes. Plan: lower Route53 TTL to 30s, then change weighted routing to send 100% to dp-43. Preparing change batch now.
Ben (eng-sre): I'll execute the DNS weight shift. Running: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZXXXXX --change-batch file://shift-dp43.json`
Response: `ChangeInfo: Zchange-CCCC queued`
IncidentBot: Route53 change queued (propagation pending).
Ajay (net-ops): after shift, NAT metrics show SNAT usage dropping and conntrack entries decreasing.
Ben (eng-sre): 5xx rate dropped from ~18% to ~1.2% within ~90s of the traffic shift. dp-43 target health is green.
Rachel (customer-success): sent update to EdenWorks: "We routed traffic to a warm pool to restore service; engineering is investigating root cause. No customer data exposure. We'll follow up with a postmortem."
Emily (support): Customer confirms errors reduced and users are back online. Marking customer impact as mitigated.
Maya (oncall): next actions: 1) eng-runtime to investigate pod crash loop/root cause (Ben) 2) net-ops to audit recent SG change and NAT capacity (Ajay) 3) infra to add NAT capacity or reserve ports if needed. Assigning tasks to Ben/Ajay.
Ben (eng-sre): collecting logs now. Initial signs: pod OOMs and intermittent node-level network errors; will capture core dumps and request metrics.
Ajay (net-ops): rolling back the SG tweak in staging to repro, posting audit link: https://redwood.internal/audit/sg/12345. Will propose a safer egress policy and nat capacity plan.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Incident status set to MITIGATED. Start: 6791234500. Mitigated: 6791234560. Please file incident report and link this thread.
Maya (oncall): filing incident ticket INC-6791-edenworks and scheduling a blameless postmortem. Thanks everyone for quick coordination.
